title: identity.sms_requested.v1
description: Command of identity. A resident OTP or a member invitation (FR-15.1, FR-17.1).

buildingId.description: The building, or `null` for an event about an account that belongs to no single building (resident sign-in, sessions, deletion).

requestId.description: A fresh id per send; the aggregate key.

accountId.description: The resident account whose phone receives the message.

params.description: Template parameters that are not secrets, e.g. `{"unitCode": "A-1508"}`.

secretEnc.description: The OTP, AES-256-GCM encrypted (`v1:<keyId>:<iv>:<ciphertext+tag>`, DR-117); `null` for an invitation.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the message is useless (the OTP expiry; for an invitation, creation + 5 min).
